producer_report.summary: LandingCommit now has a required snake_case `kind` (LandingKind: job_landing, declared_intervention, records_only). `job` and `verification` are Option and omitted from JSON when absent. deny_unknown_fields is kept. A new LandingCommit::validate, called from Landing::validate, requires both fields for job_landing and refuses both for the other two kinds. It uses two new HistoryError variants, MissingForKind and NotAllowedForKind. gh.rs commits() sets JobLanding with Some job and verification; intent() collects job ids only from commits that have a job; the test constructor is updated. CHANGELOG has an entry. land.rs and manage.rs are untouched.

open_issues: manage.rs is a listed deliverable but needed no change, so I left it alone, as the plan allowed.
intent() now skips commits with no job when collecting job_ids. The request does not settle this; part 2 should confirm it.
A landing whose commits are all non-job would give an empty job_ids list, and LandingIntent::validate rejects that. This is for part 2 to resolve.
learnings: manage.rs, display.rs and land.rs do not use LandingCommit fields, so only gh.rs needed changes outside history.rs.
Landing records written before this change have no `kind` and will no longer parse; the history.rs module docs say production does not read the records branch yet.
